purpose: Freeze the evidence-hardening state immediately before U.S. outreach review, including the new Threads celebrity-reply/youth-persona lead without promoting unresolved attribution to fact.

strong_spine.claim: Russia/Russian-backed forces repeatedly neutralized, seized, substituted or rerouted information-distribution infrastructure during conflicts.
Occupied Ukrainian networks were rerouted through Russian upstreams, demonstrating modern Internet-path/distribution capture.
TSPU is widely deployed, in-path and centrally controlled inside Russia.
TSPU supports flexible selective protocol censorship; Russian domestic practice includes regional/mobile denial and deny-except-allowlist operation.
Russian SORM/surveillance technology has proliferated abroad through multiple vendors and telecom customers.
Russian government-linked social-media bot farms and fake-persona influence campaigns are independently confirmed by DOJ/FBI and Meta.
Russia-linked influence networks have historically used non-political lifestyle/celebrity content for audience growth and fake-account engagement amplification.
Direct celebrity replies/retweets are associated with stronger adolescent parasocial relationships; influencers can act as perceived digital super peers for adolescents.
A March 2026 Baskov/Bilan celebrity reply wave in Threads and the public reply-expectation meme are independently documented.

current_threads_lead.user_observation: Accounts presenting as teenage/young women approximately 15-18+ in persona appear to promote Baskov/Bilan using a celebrity-reply hook and flashmob/social-proof loop.
not_established: the account operators are Russian state-linked
the account holders are actually minors
the current Threads wave is coupled to TSPU or other network-control activity
current_threads_lead.why_agencies_can_do_more: Platform/law-enforcement telemetry can test shared devices, IP/network infrastructure, creation patterns, payment/advertising links, operator overlap, enforcement history and cross-platform attribution unavailable to open-source review.

combined_threat_model.lane_A_network_control: DENY -> ALLOWLIST -> FILTER -> ROUTE/POLICY CONTROL -> OBSERVE REMAINDER
combined_threat_model.lane_B_platform_influence: FAKE PERSONAS -> AUDIENCE SEEDING -> REPLY BAIT/SOCIAL PROOF -> ENGAGEMENT AMPLIFICATION -> POSSIBLE NARRATIVE DELIVERY
combined_threat_model.candidate_combination: External/open communications become less reachable while selected local services and socially amplified aligned content remain available.

hard_stops: No Roskomnadzor-operated TSPU nodes in sovereign third countries established.
No Russian state remote command of sovereign foreign SORM/DPI established.
No synchronized multi-country TSPU activation established.
No direct coupling of current Threads celebrity wave to TSPU established.
No DPRK-to-TSPU specific method transfer established.
No universal military C2 denial claim; only affected public-network dependencies are within scope.
No 'low IQ' population labeling in agency communications; use measurable susceptibility/parasocial/social-proof mechanisms instead.
